name: nimblescape-mindbug
description: Shows the stack (one scope for each function call) and the heap of a paused TypeScript program as a diagram, to help students learn how memory works. Starts the program with the command ts of nimblescape TypeScript in the JavaScript debugger of VS Code, and, while its view is open, at each pause runs a small helper in the program that reads its objects and changes nothing.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Mindbug starts the TypeScript program of the workspace with the command ts and runs code in it, and VS Code debugs a program only in a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Node.js runs a file on the disk, which a virtual workspace does not have.

nimblescape.mindbug.stopOnEntry.markdownDescription: When on, **Run with Mindbug** and a launch configuration of type `mindbug` pause at the first line of the program, so you can step from the start. The attribute `stopOnEntry` of a launch configuration wins over this setting. A click on the switch **Stop on entry** of the Mindbug view changes this setting in the user settings, unless the settings of the workspace set it.

nimblescape.mindbug.openAutomatically.description: Open the Mindbug view when a debug session pauses for the first time.

nimblescape.mindbug.showClasses.markdownDescription: Show the classes, with their static variables, at the top of the heap in the Mindbug view. A click on the switch **Show classes** of the view changes this setting in the user settings, unless the settings of the workspace set it.

nimblescape.mindbug.showFunctions.markdownDescription: Show functions, and the variables that hold functions or classes, in the Mindbug view. A click on the switch **Show functions** of the view changes this setting in the user settings, unless the settings of the workspace set it.

nimblescape.mindbug.showIds.markdownDescription: Show the number of each object in the Mindbug view, which stays the same from step to step. A click on the switch **Show ids** of the view changes this setting in the user settings, unless the settings of the workspace set it.

nimblescape.mindbug.showUninitialized.markdownDescription: Show the variables whose line has not run yet in the Mindbug view: a `let`, `const` or `class` before its line, as "uninitialized". A click on the switch **Show uninitialized** of the view changes this setting in the user settings, unless the settings of the workspace set it.

nimblescape.mindbug.showScopeFrames.markdownDescription: Draw each block scope as a colored part in the box of its scope in the Mindbug view and, while the program is paused, as a rectangle with the same color around its lines in the editor. When it is off, the variables of the blocks are in the box of their scope, and the editor has no rectangles. A click on the switch **Show scope frames** of the view changes this setting in the user settings, unless the settings of the workspace set it.

nimblescape.mindbug.maxHistorySteps.description: Maximum number of steps that the Mindbug view keeps, so that you can go back to an earlier step. When there are more steps, the oldest steps are removed.

nimblescape.mindbug.maxObjects.description: Maximum number of heap objects that are read per step, for all scopes together.

nimblescape.mindbug.maxArrayItems.description: Maximum number of array items, set members and map entries that are shown per object.

nimblescape.mindbug.maxStringLength.description: Maximum number of characters that are shown per string.

colors.description: Mindbug: the color of a block scope at nesting level 1 (the outermost block of a function), for the mark in the editor and the border of its part in the Mindbug view.
Mindbug: the color of a block scope at nesting level 2, for the mark in the editor and the border of its part in the Mindbug view.
Mindbug: the color of a block scope at nesting level 3, for the mark in the editor and the border of its part in the Mindbug view.
Mindbug: the color of a block scope at nesting level 4, for the mark in the editor and the border of its part in the Mindbug view. Level 5 has the color of level 1 again, and so on.

program.description: The TypeScript file to run. The default is the file of the active editor.

cwd.description: The folder in which the program runs. The default is the workspace folder.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause at the first statement of the program. The default is the setting nimblescape.mindbug.stopOnEntry.

console.description: Where the program runs and writes its output. The default of the debug type ts is integratedTerminal, where prompt() can read the input.

configurationSnippets.label: Mindbug: Run a TypeScript file
configurationSnippets.description: Runs a TypeScript file with the command ts and shows its memory in the Mindbug view.

scripts.test:vscode: node esbuild.mjs && node scripts/build-vscode-tests.mjs && vscode-test --label vscode
